## Summary

- Add `docs/agent-workflow-convention.md`, the org-wide agent workflow convention: one worktree per branch (never reuse), captured (never guessed) PR numbers, and serial dispatch for same-domain subagents.
- Downstream repositories' `AGENTS.md` files cite this document instead of re-deriving the rules per repository; the doc states that premise up front.
- The PR-number rule records the observed failure (a cache-mesh PR merged through a guessed adjacent number) so the rationale is not lost.

## Verification

- Docs-only change; no build required.
- `celestia-devtools format-markdown --check docs/agent-workflow-convention.md` passes.
- Commit/PR title follows the gitmoji convention (`📝`).
